An AI finance agent that lets you invest alongside top investors across markets. Launch app Built for markets, data, and execution The best way to invest with agents One account, every market Bring your portfolio into context Connect wallets, exchanges, brokers, and tokens so your AI Finance Agent understands your positions, exposure, and available capital across markets. Connect accounts Proven returns Invest with AI Agents Top investor strategy becomes AI Agents you can follow, understand, and invest with. Compare performance, risk, deposits, and capacity, then choose the agent your capital follows. AI Agents Personalized financial harness Power your agent with live intelligence Models reason. Skills define strategy. Plugins bring market data, research, and on-chain signals. Accounts let your agent monitor and act within the permissions you set. Financial harness Launch app Agentic Trading Harness Financial intelligence harness. Questflow is not a stateless trading bot. It is a persistent intelligence environment where every signal, decision, risk rule, and trade makes your AI Agent more useful. Decide which model your AI agent uses to think, reason, and make decisions. Supports leading models like GPT, Claude, and Gemini — plus purpose-built finance models to come. Switch freely by scenario so your AI performs at its best across analysis, research, and trading. Models The Brain of Your AI Agent Give your AI professional financial knowledge, investment methods, and trading strategies. Skills define how it analyzes markets and makes decisions — spanning trading strategies, investment systems, analytical frameworks, and the styles of investing greats. Install official Skills or upload your own to build a bespoke AI Investment Framework. Skills Teach Your AI How to Think Provide your AI with real-time data, research, and external tools. Plugins connect financial data sources and analytics — news, market data, on-chain data, deep research, social media, and more — so your AI works from the latest information and reasons across multiple dimensions. Plugins Give Your AI Access to the Financial World Connect your real assets so your AI moves from analysis to execution. Link exchanges, brokerages, wallets, and more over time. Once authorized, it can read balances, analyze positions, and manage your portfolio — executing natural-language or automated trades through your own accounts, closing the loop from analysis to decision to execution.
